_note: Hand-curated France CAP table. Coupled rates match the France fact check. Eco-scheme and basic-income values are provisional (to confirm with TelePAC 2026). This file is the single source for every CAP number in the app, including the Calculator.

programmes.title: Protein crop support
programmes.what: Paid for growing pea, faba bean, lupin, soy or dry pulses.
eligibility: Legumes must be more than half of the seed in a mixture.
Mixtures with grasses are paid in the sowing year only.
Declare the field in your yearly CAP declaration (TelePAC).
programmes.note: The rate moves each year with claims and budget.

programmes.title: Fodder legume support
programmes.what: Paid for lucerne, clover and other fodder legumes.
eligibility: Keep at least 5 livestock units, or have a contract with a livestock farmer.

programmes.title: Eco-scheme
programmes.what: A yearly payment on all your hectares once you collect enough points.
eligibility: Base level from 4 points, higher level from 5.
Legumes on at least 10% of your arable land add 3 points, at least 5% add 2.

programmes.title: Crop rotation rule
programmes.what: You must change crops on your arable land to receive CAP payments.
eligibility: A legume counts as a crop change.

programmes.title: Regional agri-environment contract
programmes.what: A 5-year contract with extra payments for farming practices.
eligibility: Offers differ by region; ask your chamber of agriculture.
Cannot be paid twice for the same practice as the eco-scheme.

programmes.title: Simpler CAP rules
programmes.what: Fewer checks (one on-the-spot inspection a year) and up to 3,000 € for small farms.
eligibility: Applies to all farms; no extra step to join.

programmes.title: Written contracts for farmers
programmes.what: Buyers will have to put the deal with farmers in writing.
eligibility: Contracts in this app already show terms in writing.
programmes.note: Final adoption and date to confirm.

programmes.title: New CAP from 2028
programmes.what: One fund per country, national plans due in 2027. Legume support is not decided.
programmes.note: Today's rates run to the end of 2027.
